papers.title: SparseLoom: Structured Sparsity for Long-Context Retrieval
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Workshop on Efficient Retrieval

facts.question: What method does 'SparseLoom: Structured Sparsity for Long-Context Retrieval' introduce?
facts.evidence: We present SparseLoom, a block-sparse attention approach to long-context passage retrieval.

facts.question: Which dataset is SparseLoom evaluated on?
facts.evidence: We evaluate on LoomBench, which contains 48,000 examples.

facts.question: What nDCG@10 does SparseLoom achieve on LoomBench?
facts.evidence: SparseLoom reaches 61.4 nDCG@10 on LoomBench.

facts.question: What does the DenseWeave baseline achieve on LoomBench?
facts.evidence: The DenseWeave baseline reaches 54.9 nDCG@10 under the identical protocol.

facts.question: How much nDCG@10 is lost when removing the block router in SparseLoom?
facts.evidence: With removing the block router, nDCG@10 falls by 4.8 points
